idea-plugin.name: Cloudflare D1 Driver
idea-plugin.description:
Browse, query and edit Cloudflare® D1 databases in the database tools.

Add a data source, select Cloudflare D1, and enter your Cloudflare account ID. Use a Cloudflare API token with D1 permission as the password. The IDE downloads the open source driver from GitHub when you first connect.

Source code and help: github.com/simontong/d1-jdbc
